name: Protect Closet Shelving — Partial Cover
intent: Medium protection: plastic sheet covers upper shelves, leave lower accessible. Use when painting walls or ceiling of a closet.
doctrine: Derived from wood_shelving baseline × 1.0 level multiplier (setup 1.5 min/LF = 40 LF/hr, teardown 0.5 min/LF = 120 LF/hr). Obstruction level-independent (1 min/LF = 60 LF/hr). See legacy closet-shelving-protection.js rates for source.
